# lumos_access_policies (Data Source)

An access policy: the apps and entitlements that identities matching its condition can get. Destroying it doesn't revoke access already granted through it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Policies whose name matches, ignoring case. Leave name out to list every
# access policy.
data "lumos_access_policies" "engineering" {
  name = "Engineering tools"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Filter by policy name (case insensitive)

### Read-Only

- `access_policies` (Attributes List) The organization's access policies, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_policies))

<a id="nestedatt--access_policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_policies`

Read-Only:

- `access_condition` (String) The Lumos Condition object determining which identities qualify for this policy. For more information, see the [Lumos Conditions documentation](https://docs.lumos.com/kb/life_cycle_management/building-conditions-in-lumos). Parsed as JSON.
- `apps` (Attributes Set) The apps and entitlements granted by this access policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_policies--apps))
- `business_justification` (String) Explanation for why this policy exists.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the access policy.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the access policy is enabled.
- `is_everyone_condition` (Boolean) True when the policy applies to everyone in your organization. `access_condition` is then null.
- `name` (String) The name of the access policy.
- `status` (String) The status of the access policy.

<a id="nestedatt--access_policies--apps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_policies.apps`

Read-Only:

- `entitlements` (Attributes Set) The entitlements granted for this app. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_policies--apps--entitlements))
- `id` (String) The ID of this app.
- `is_preapproved` (Boolean) Whether requests created via this access policy are pre-approved.

<a id="nestedatt--access_policies--apps--entitlements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_policies.apps.entitlements`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The UUID of the entitlement.
